text:
maya: Quick morning blitz — SDKs/quickstarts/doc fixes status (what I did / blockers / today)

alex: Did: landed examples for node streaming in samplekit (PR #482).
Blocker: CI flakes on macOS-latest for the ESM build, still debugging.
Today: triage CI flakes, ping infra for mac runner logs.

pranav: Did: updated python quickstart to include token-usage snippet and error handling.
Blocker: need a short blurb from security about KMS config for the private deployment sample.
Today: add unit test for example, open docs PR.

kiara: Did: docs lint pass and tiny copy edits for the embeddings guide.
Blocker: screenshots for the console dashboard need the new UI (waiting on design).
Today: stub out alt text placeholders so localization team can start.

maya: FYI I rebased the sampleapp branch to main and fixed the import path issue for the rust shim.
Added a smoke test that runs locally with `cargo run --example sample_infer`.

sam: Quick note — I saw the macOS ESM failure on CI, looks like node14 vs node18 mismatch inside the runner image.
Workaround: install node 18 in the workflow before build. I'll push a hotfix to the CI YAML. :gear:

alex: Awesome — if you push that CI change can you tag me? I want to re-run the node streaming tests.

sam: Yup, pushing in a sec.

pranav: @kiara re: KMS blurb — I can draft a short paragraph explaining how to set environment variables and link to our KMS doc. Want me to drop it in the PR?

kiara: Please do — include one sentence about never committing keys and mention HSM option. :lock:

maya: Blocker for me: sampleapp startup is flaky when running with quantized model on g5. Need someone to reproduce on a g5-devec2 instance.

alex: I can spin one up for a quick repro after my triage. 30–60 min ETA.

docs-bot: Reminder: staging site deploy scheduled at 09:30 PT. Any last-minute docs changes must be merged by 09:00 PT to make the deploy.

maya: Noted — I'll aim to merge the rust shim fix by 08:50 PT.

pranav: PR #489 (python quickstart tests) opened, request review from @maya and @kiara.

kiara: Reviewing now, left one tiny wording nit on the error-handling section.

sam: CI hotfix pushed: `ci/setup-node.yml` now forces node 18 for mac runners. Re-ran the macos workflow — one flaky test still failing, investigating.

alex: Thank you. After CI green, can someone run a quick smoke on M1 mac locally? I want to confirm streaming + ESM works for M1.

maya: I can run on M1 later today, will report back here.

pranav: Quick ask: can we add a short checklist to the sampleapp README for 'local dev on Macs', e.g., required node version, rust toolchain, known env vars? Saves time for new contributors.

kiara: Yes, please add — I'll review it for style.

maya: Okay — action items summarised:
- alex: repro on g5 and report (30–60 min)
- sam: continue CI flake triage (node/macos)
- pranav: add KMS blurb + README checklist, PR #489 opened
- kiara: review PRs + provide final screenshots alt text placeholders
- maya: merge rust shim fix before 08:50 PT and run M1 smoke later

alex: one last note — tagging @support if the g5 repro shows a scheduling/perf regression so they can check cluster autoscaler logs.

maya: thanks all. Short and focused today — ping here with any blockers. :thumbsup:
